changes.risk: Unrelated commits from other shards could block an otherwise valid detached child.
changes.fix: Require local HEAD to be an ancestor of fetched remote HEAD.

changes.risk: A forward remote commit could alter Gas execution files.
changes.fix: Require wrapper, carrier and harness blobs to match at local and remote refs.

changes.risk: Child could fail when AAYS_PORTABLE_ROOT is not inherited.
changes.fix: Resolve portable root from canonical runner_system ancestry as a fallback.

changes.risk: Remote could advance again between wrapper and carrier startup.
changes.fix: Carrier consumes wrapper-validated ancestry and blob parity evidence; current remote is informational.

nonclaims: This is not canonical browser acceptance.
This does not prove 100 DOM rows on port 8012.
This does not authorize measured parcel values.
This does not set final_ready true.
